title: Egg Muffins

items: 1 cup cooked sausage crumbles or diced ham

steps: Heat the oven to 350°F with a rack in the middle. Coat a 12-cup muffin tin well with cooking spray, including the top rim.
Divide the bell pepper, sausage or ham and cheese evenly among the cups, about ¼ cup in each.
In a large bowl, whisk the eggs, milk, salt and pepper until no streaks of white remain. Pour into a liquid measuring cup.
Pour the eggs over the fillings until each cup is about ¾ full. They puff as they bake.
Bake 20–25 min, until puffed, the tops are set and don't jiggle, and the center of one reads 160°F.
Cool in the tin 5 min. They sink a little as they cool. Run a butter knife around each one and lift it out.
tips: Always use cooked sausage or ham. Raw meat won't cook through in the time it takes the eggs to set.
Sauté the bell pepper 3–4 min first if you like it soft instead of crisp.
Silicone muffin cups, or paper liners sprayed with oil, make them release more easily.
storage: Cool completely, then refrigerate up to 4 days or freeze up to 2 months in a zip-top bag. Reheat in the microwave 30–45 sec from the fridge, or 60–90 sec from frozen, until hot in the center.
